decisions.quote: Overall findings of our first direct interview family study of obsessive–compulsive disorder (OCD) indicated that OCD is familial. In this replication study, we carefully examined the role of informant data in ascertaining OCD in relatives.
decisions.reason: NEW independent publisher-deposited PartIabstract explicitly identifies this and its companion as two sequential direct-interview family studies with different samples/procedures. PartI179relatives/72OCDprobands versus112relatives/32controls yields the familial-OCD claim; currentPartII112relatives/57patients versus115relatives/41controls explicitly replicates our first study and tests the proband-informant contribution. Reciprocal primary companion descriptions and distinct stated samples identify existing886PartI10.1017/S0033291705005441, beyond PartI/IItitle matching alone. Exact current reference/body remains inaccessible, but the described original has a unique positively identified companion. No additional missing pair or original-specific outcome is assigned.
